reports.title: Duckett Fishing’s Crappie Slayer Rod
reports.text:
Duckett Fishing introduces the new Crappie Slayer, an update to its established panfish rod featuring a carbon-reinforced handle system and low-profile cork grip. Whether anglers are shooting docks, casting swimbaits, or targeting fish with forward facing sonar, the newly improved Crappie Slayer delivers tournament-level performance at an exceptional value.
What separates the Crappie Slayer from traditional panfish rods is its distinct tip-to-backbone transition. The responsive tip helps anglers detect subtle bites and present baits naturally, while the powerful lower section provides the control needed to confidently land trophy-sized crappie and other panfish.

reports.title: Mister Twister’s 7-inch RT Slug SI
reports.text:
Mister Twister rep Greg Yates lifts a 7-pound bass up high after catching it in May, two months before the soft plastic was released by Mister Twister.
This salt-infused soft plastic captivates bass with its lifelike colors and movement
An Oak Point, Texas, bass fisherman got his hands on a new soft plastic jerkbait 5 ½ months ago that impressed him with its ability to consistently get bass to open their jaws and chomp.
Greg Yates was one of the lucky ones at the time because Mister Twister’s 7-inch RT Slug SI soft plastic just hit the market in late summer, according to sales manager Darryl Laurent. The first orders went out in mid-August, Laurent said.
